notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Nmap scan of Oracle TNS listener (port 1521) with oracle* NSE scripts. Fingerprints TNS version, identifies named instances, and provides the foundation for SID brute forcing and ODAT exploitation.

=== CHAINING ===
nmap oracle-tns → TNS version + listener info → oracle-sid-brute → ODAT all modules → exploitation.
